    • capacitive

      public static RealGasPipeDecompression.WallThermalBoundary capacitive(double gasToWallCoefficientWPerM2K, double wallToEnvironmentCoefficientWPerM2K, double wallArealHeatCapacityJPerM2K, double initialWallTemperatureK, double externalTemperatureK)
      Creates a finite-capacitance wall coupled separately to gas and a fixed environment.

      The wall uses one lumped temperature per axial cell and no radial temperature profile. Coefficients, areal heat capacity and temperatures are caller-prescribed SI inputs; this factory does not derive material properties or fire, soil, ambient or seawater correlations.

      Parameters:
      gasToWallCoefficientWPerM2K - gas-to-wall coefficient in W/(m2 K)
      wallToEnvironmentCoefficientWPerM2K - wall-to-environment coefficient in W/(m2 K)
      wallArealHeatCapacityJPerM2K - wall heat capacity per pipe external area in J/(m2 K)
      initialWallTemperatureK - initial uniform wall temperature in K
      externalTemperatureK - fixed environment temperature in K
      Returns:
      immutable capacitive boundary

    • cylindricalLumpedWall

      public static RealGasPipeDecompression.WallThermalBoundary cylindricalLumpedWall(double innerDiameterM, double wallThicknessM, double wallDensityKgPerM3, double wallSpecificHeatJPerKgK, double wallConductivityWPerMK, double innerFilmCoefficientWPerM2K, double outerFilmCoefficientWPerM2K, double initialWallTemperatureK, double externalTemperatureK)
      Derives a lumped cylindrical wall boundary from explicit geometry and material properties.

      The heat-transfer area is the cylinder outer area. The supplied inner film coefficient is converted to that area, and the wall heat capacity is derived from the annular material volume. The lumped temperature approximation is accepted only when max(hInner, hOuter) * (outerDiameter - innerDiameter) / (4 * conductivity) < 0.1. This fail-closed check is an applicability guard, not a radial-conduction solution or material-property database.

      Parameters:
      innerDiameterM - pipe internal diameter in m
      wallThicknessM - wall thickness in m
      wallDensityKgPerM3 - wall material density in kg/m3
      wallSpecificHeatJPerKgK - wall material specific heat in J/(kg K)
      wallConductivityWPerMK - wall material conductivity in W/(m K)
      innerFilmCoefficientWPerM2K - gas-side film coefficient on inner area in W/(m2 K)
      outerFilmCoefficientWPerM2K - environment-side film coefficient on outer area in W/(m2 K)
      initialWallTemperatureK - initial uniform wall temperature in K
      externalTemperatureK - fixed environment temperature in K
      Returns:
      immutable material-derived lumped wall boundary

    • cylindricalTwoNodeWall

      public static RealGasPipeDecompression.WallThermalBoundary cylindricalTwoNodeWall(double innerDiameterM, double wallThicknessM, double wallDensityKgPerM3, double wallSpecificHeatJPerKgK, double wallConductivityWPerMK, double innerFilmCoefficientWPerM2K, double outerFilmCoefficientWPerM2K, double initialWallTemperatureK, double externalTemperatureK)
      Derives a conservative two-node radial cylindrical wall from explicit geometry and material properties.

      The annulus is split into equal-volume inner and outer control volumes. Each node retains its own temperature. The node-to-node conductance uses the exact cylindrical resistance between the two volume-centroid radii. Film coefficients and all wall properties remain caller-supplied SI inputs; this factory neither predicts boundary correlations nor represents more than two radial wall nodes.

      Parameters:
      innerDiameterM - pipe internal diameter in m
      wallThicknessM - wall thickness in m
      wallDensityKgPerM3 - wall material density in kg/m3
      wallSpecificHeatJPerKgK - wall material specific heat in J/(kg K)
      wallConductivityWPerMK - wall material conductivity in W/(m K)
      innerFilmCoefficientWPerM2K - gas-side film coefficient on inner area in W/(m2 K)
      outerFilmCoefficientWPerM2K - environment-side film coefficient on outer area in W/(m2 K)
      initialWallTemperatureK - initial uniform wall temperature in K
      externalTemperatureK - fixed environment temperature in K
      Returns:
      immutable two-node radial material wall boundary
